6a60f9cb4c0634f3.job_title: Business Assurance Controls & Analytics Specialist VOIS
6a60f9cb4c0634f3.description: About Vodafone Intelligent Solutions (VOIS) VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) operates as a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, focusing on delivering intelligent solutions through talent, technology, and transformation. As the largest shared services organization in the global telco industry, with 30,000 full-time employees, VOIS designs next-generation solutions and services in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify operations and drive growth. The organization works with customers in 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations, including Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, and Ireland, supported by teams in the Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. The Role of Business Assurance Financial Controls Specialist Vodafone is seeking a Business Assurance Financial Controls Specialist to join the team in Al Qatif. This full-time role involves working on financial controls that contribute to billing accuracy, margin protection, reliable reporting, and customer-account integrity. The specialist will collaborate with Finance, Commercial, Billing, IT, and operational teams, using evidence-based findings to influence corrective actions and strengthen sustainable controls. This position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Execute risk-based controls and reviews across contract-to-invoice processes, customer accounts, service configuration, billing, and customer profitability. Investigate anomalies and potential financial leakage by tracing transactions, validating evidence, identifying root causes, and documenting clear conclusions. Reconcile financial and operational data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy, repeatability, and a complete audit trail. Prepare financial-impact reports covering identified, prevented, and recovered exposure, alongside risks, causes, and recommended actions. Partner with first-line teams to agree on corrective actions, monitor remediation through to closure, and improve controls while maintaining independent professional judgment. Required Qualifications and Experience A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a comparable field. At least three years of relevant professional experience in financial control, business assurance, investigation, reconciliation, or a comparable specialist role. Practical experience analyzing large volumes of financial and operational data and producing evidence-based reports. Essential Skills Strong financial reporting and reconciliation skills, with the ability to quantify financial impact and communicate findings clearly. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or similar applications, including pivot tables, lookups, data validation, reconciliation, and structured reporting. The ability to prioritize independently, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with remote and international stakeholders. Work Environment This role is based in Al Qatif and involves working within Business Assurance, collaborating across various financial, commercial, billing, IT, and operational teams. The position requires combining financial analysis, investigation, and professional judgment to identify risks and support effective corrective actions.

6ab9719ae705c0e8.description: نبحث عن باريستا شغوف ومبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تقديم تجربة قهوة استثنائية لعملائنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إعداد مجموعة متنوعة من مشروبات القهوة المتخصصة بمهارة ودقة، مع الحفاظ على أعلى معايير الجودة والنظافة. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة وشغفًا بالقهوة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام الرئيسية: * إعداد وتقديم مشروبات القهوة المتخصصة (إسبريسو، لاتيه، كابتشينو، إلخ) وفقًا للوصفات المعتمدة. * ضمان جودة المكونات المستخدمة والحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل. * تقديم خدمة عملاء ودودة وفعالة، والإجابة على استفسارات العملاء حول القهوة. * المساهمة في تطوير قائمة المشروبات وابتكار وصفات جديدة. * العمل ضمن فريق لتحقيق أهداف المتجر.

6a04fa360bb0eec4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بلاديس العربية للصناعات الغذائية عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى بناء وتطوير علاقات قوية مع العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، وتقديم عروض بيع فعالة للمنتجات والخدمات، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتحصيل الديون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات). إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحية المخولة. إتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات العملاء بفعالية. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل الموظف ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف الشركة وتوسيع قاعدة عملائها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة بلاديس العربية للصناعات الغذائية.

6a7d9f5c2736cd4e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تشكيل بلس المحدودة عن مصمم أثاث للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ابتكار تصميمات جديدة للمنتجات الخشبية، بما في ذلك الأثاث واكسسواراته، وتجهيز المواصفات الفنية اللازمة للإنتاج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية رسم نماذج أولية وتفصيلية لمنتجات الأثاث واكسسواراتها لوضع أسس التصميمات الجديدة. التشاور مع فرق المبيعات، والإدارة، والعملاء لمناقشة التصميم والتحسينات المطلوبة. إنتاج نماذج أولية، وتقييم المواصفات وأشكال المنتج وأساليب الإنتاج، وتكرار التصميم لضمان إخراج المنتج في أفضل صورة. فحص المنتجات بعد عملية الإنتاج لضمان الالتزام بالتصميم والمواصفات. مباشرة أعمال الفنيين والمقاولين والموردين، وإبلاغ فريق الإنتاج عن الاختلافات في العقود. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تصميم الأثاث أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على ابتكار تصميمات جديدة للمنتجات الخشبية. معرفة بالمواد الخام والأبعاد ومتطلبات الإنتاج. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة بريدة، القصيم. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع فرق العمل الداخلية والعملاء لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج في تصميم المنتجات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

6adbf57964eb6ff5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سماء للاستشارات الهندسية عن فني حساب كميات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. يركز الدور على حساب كميات المواد اللازمة للمشاريع وإعداد المطالبات المالية. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى ضمان دقة حسابات الكميات للمواد والأعمال المنجزة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتدقيق المطالبات المالية للمشاريع. يشمل ذلك دراسة المخططات والمواصفات الفنية لتقدير التكاليف وضمان الامتثال للمعايير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات الهندسية للمشروع والمواصفات الفنية والشروط العامة والخاصة. حساب كميات المواد اللازمة لتنفيذ الأعمال. حساب كميات المواد الموردة للموقع. بيان الأسعار والكلف التقديرية لبنود الأعمال والكلفة الإجمالية للمشروع. إعداد جداول كميات الأعمال المنجزة وتفريغها على النماذج الخاصة. إعداد المطالبات المالية للمشروع وتدقيقها. توثيق التعديلات الطارئة على أسعار البنود المختلفة. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال حساب الكميات. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية. معرفة جيدة بأساليب حساب الكميات وإعداد الجداول والمطالبات المالية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة الوظيفية في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة سماء للاستشارات الهندسية. يتم التركيز على بيئة عمل منظمة تلتزم بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الوظيفة في الرياض.

6a203bfd12760031.description: About Carbonex Carbonex is a growing supplier specializing in industrial gases, minerals, and related products. The company serves customers across Saudi Arabia, focusing on quality, reliable service, and customer satisfaction to build long-term business relationships. The Sales Executive Role Carbonex is seeking a Sales Executive for a full-time, on-site position based in the Western Region of Saudi Arabia, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah. This role is crucial for expanding the company's customer base and managing client relationships within the region. Key Responsibilities Develop new business opportunities to expand the company's market reach. Manage existing customer relationships to ensure satisfaction and foster loyalty. Promote Carbonex products effectively to potential and current clients. Prepare accurate quotations and proposals for prospective deals. Negotiate deals to achieve favorable terms for the company. Achieve established sales targets and contribute to overall business growth. Monitor market trends and identify opportunities for business expansion. Qualifications and Requirements A valid Saudi driving license is required, along with a willingness to travel extensively within the Western Region. A Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in sales is required for this role. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time, on-site position based in the Western Region of Saudi Arabia, with primary focus on the cities of Jeddah and Makkah. The role requires regular travel within these areas to meet business objectives.

6a57c5231b0e8a63.description: About the Role Systems Arabia is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead and manage technology projects, with a strong preference for candidates possessing ERP implementation experience. This full-time, on-site position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves overseeing projects from initiation to successful delivery within defined parameters. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end project planning and delivery, from initiation through implementation and closure. Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, issues, and dependencies. Oversee ERP implementation, enhancement, or transformation projects. Coordinate effectively with business, technical, vendor, and cross-functional teams. Gather requirements and translate business needs into actionable project plans. Track project milestones, deliverables, KPIs, and overall project progress. Identify and mitigate project risks, and resolve issues through effective escalation and coordination. Manage stakeholder communication and provide regular project status updates. Ensure projects are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, and budget. Support testing, deployment, go-live, and post-implementation activities. Required Qualifications and Experience Demonstrated experience as a Project Manager in technology projects. Preferably, strong experience in ERP implementation. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant professional experience. Work Environment This is a full-time, on-site position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires active participation within a team environment to ensure project success.

6a5a01a83b990237.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة الوطنية لحلول الأعمال عن أخصائي عقود للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم المشورة وإدارة ومراجعة وتنفيذ العقود المختلفة وشؤون المناقصات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديث كافة البيانات المتعلقة بالعقود حسب الحاجة. إدخال البيانات إلى معالج النصوص والتطبيقات المخصصة. صياغة وتحرير وترجمة جميع أنواع العقود والوثائق ذات الصلة. تدقيق وضبط العقود والوثائق لضمان تحقيق وتنفيذ الشروط والمواصفات التعاقدية المتفق عليها بين الأطراف المعنية. المتابعة المستمرة مع الإدارات المعنية والجهات الخارجية بخصوص المواضيع ذات العلاقة بالعقود. إعداد التقارير الدورية ورفعها إلى المدير المباشر. تنفيذ العمليات التشغيلية لمكتب المشاريع. إعداد كراسة الشروط والمواصفات للمناقصات والمشاريع. تقديم المقترحات الهادفة إلى التطوير والتحسين الإداري في مجال العقود. القيام بأي أعمال أخرى تُكلف بها وتتعلق بطبيعة عمله. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال العقود أو ما يعادلها. فهم عميق لإدارة العقود وشؤون المناقصات. القدرة على صياغة وتحرير وتدقيق الوثائق القانونية والتعاقدية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الكتابي والشفوي. القدرة على العمل بفعالية مع الأقسام الداخلية والجهات الخارجية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد ومراجعة الوثائق. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الدورية وتقديم المقترحات التطويرية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي العقود ضمن فريق متخصص في الشركة الوطنية لحلول الأعمال بالدمام. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة بالمنطقة الشرقية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الشركة الوطنية لحلول الأعمال.

6ae8f5a65fe67e7a.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a Site Architect to oversee and monitor architectural construction activities. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and involves working on a major infrastructure and landscape development project. The role requires 0-1 years of experience and focuses on ensuring architectural works comply with project requirements and industry standards. Role Context and Purpose The Site Architect will function on behalf of the Project Management Consultant (PMC), coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary stakeholders. This position is critical for ensuring that all architectural aspects of the project are executed according to approved designs, technical specifications, quality standards, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements. The Site Architect will provide site-based technical leadership and manage design implementation throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Lead and monitor architectural construction activities from design review through construction, commissioning, and project handover. Review and monitor architectural design deliverables, drawings, specifications, shop drawings, mock-ups, and engineering submissions. Ensure architectural works comply with project requirements, local authority regulations, urban design guidelines, and international standards. Oversee contractor performance and monitor construction progress against approved schedules, milestones, and architectural design intent. Review and approve architectural shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, RFIs, and technical submissions. Coordinate architectural interfaces with civil, structural, landscape, infrastructure, MEP, and specialist systems. Conduct regular site inspections to verify quality, workmanship, aesthetics, material installations, and compliance with approved designs and specifications. Monitor project risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impacts on quality, cost, and schedule. Facilitate coordination meetings with contractors, consultants, clients, utility providers, and project stakeholders. Evaluate site changes, variations, architectural claims, and design modifications and provide recommendations. Track project KPIs, progress reports, inspection records, snagging reports, and performance metrics for management and client review. Ensure proper testing, commissioning, snagging, de-snagging, and handover procedures related to architectural works are completed successfully. Support procurement activities including technical evaluations of architectural materials, finishes, mock-ups, and vendor assessments. Drive resolution of technical, design, and construction issues affecting project delivery. Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, sustainability, and quality management requirements. Lead, mentor, and support junior architects, inspectors, and project teams involved in architectural delivery activities. Experience and Qualifications 0-1 years of experience in a relevant architectural role. Demonstrated ability to oversee and monitor architectural construction activities. Experience in coordinating with various project stakeholders. Familiarity with project requirements, technical specifications, and quality standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on site-based activities for a significant infrastructure and landscape development project. The role involves working within a multidisciplinary team and engaging with various external parties to ensure project success.

6a43dc53e196f79e.description: About Algihaz Holding Algihaz Holding is seeking an experienced Automation Engineer to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for professionals with 5-10 years of experience in the field. The Role of Automation Engineer The Automation Engineer will be responsible for critical testing, commissioning, and technical support activities related to Substation Automation Systems. This role involves direct engagement with various departments to ensure seamless project execution and reporting. Key Responsibilities Perform Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). Support testing and commissioning activities for Substation Automation Systems (SAS). Provide technical support to the team. Handle BCU and protection relay configuration. Prepare technical and weekly reports. Coordinate with Design, Materials, and Projects Departments. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in automation engineering. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia. The role requires on-site presence to manage testing, commissioning, and coordination activities effectively. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this Automation Engineer position at Algihaz Holding. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6aaed1f8e2b00121.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية المتنوعة، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تشخيص المشكلات الفنية وإيجاد الحلول لها. تحديد المخططات، وتقدير كميات المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات الأولية والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو الصيانة الكهربائية. فهم جيد لمبادئ تركيب وتشغيل المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفني. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع الأعمال. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة في بيئة عمل ديناميكية في الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص في الصيانة والتشغيل. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

6a0735505678d28f.description: About the Role Miraval The Red Sea is seeking a Security Team Leader to ensure a safe, secure, and peaceful environment for guests and colleagues. This full-time role, based in the Red Sea region, involves leading by example and upholding Miraval's values of integrity, respect, and wellbeing. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in a relevant security role. Key Responsibilities The Security Team Leader will be responsible for supervising daily security operations and ensuring compliance with established protocols. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Supervising daily operations of the security team to maintain a safe and secure resort environment. Ensuring all officers are well-presented, trained, and follow established procedures. Conducting regular patrols and inspections of key areas, including guest zones, colleague housing, and the perimeter. Managing shift schedules, reports, and incident documentation. Responding swiftly and effectively to emergencies, alarms, or incidents. Conducting regular fire safety, evacuation, and first-aid training with relevant departments. 6a4efc36b43e5731.description: تبحث الشركة نورا برايت في الرياض عن أشخاص للتعاون في التعريف بالشركة وخدماتها لدى الجهات والعملاء المحتملين، وتنسيق الزيارات والاجتماعات، ومتابعة فرص التعاون واستقطاب مشاريع جديدة. آلية التعاون: فرصة تعاون مستقل بالعمولة، وليست وظيفة بدوام أو راتب ثابت. المقابل نسبة متفق عليها عن كل مشروع يتم استقطابه والتعاقد عليه من خلال الطرف المتعاون. يُوثّق التعاون باتفاق مكتوب قبل بدء التواصل مع العملاء، ويُبرم عقد مستقل لكل مشروع يحدد نطاق العمل ونسبة العمولة وأساس احتسابها وشروط استحقاقها ومواعيد صرفها. مرونة في تنظيم الوقت وطريقة أداء العمل، مع تنسيق الاجتماعات والزيارات بحسب مواعيد الجهات المعنية. المهام: الوصول إلى الجهات والعملاء المحتملين والتواصل معهم. تقديم الشركة والتعريف بخدماتها بطريقة احترافية. تنسيق الاجتماعات والزيارات ومتابعة فرص التعاون. توثيق نتائج التواصل والفرص المطروحة. المتطلبات: اللباقة والثقة ومهارات التواصل والعرض والإقناع. المبادرة والقدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية. حسن التنظيم والمتابعة. الاستعداد للاجتماعات والزيارات الميدانية في الرياض. يُفضّل وجود خبرة في تطوير الأعمال أو المبيعات للشركات أو العلاقات العامة. متطلب المقابلة: إعداد محاكاة لعرض تعريفي عن شركة افتراضية من اختيار المتقدم، وتقديمه خلال المقابلة لمدة تتراوح بين ٥ و١٠ دقائق، على ألا يتجاوز ١٠ دقائق، كما لو كان يعرض خدمات الشركة على عميل محتمل. الغرض تقييم مهارات التواصل والعرض والإقناع فقط، ولا يُشترط تصميم احترافي. لن يُستخدم العرض لأغراض تجارية، ولا يُطلب إعداد مواد تخص شركتنا أو عملاءها

6ac6e76cb9003bf2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني التمديدات الكهربائية مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان سلامة وكفاءة الأنظمة الكهربائية. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية بأنواعها المختلفة (المنزلية، الصناعية، والتجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل دارات التمديدات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية، وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، ومتابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية المعقدة. معرفة قوية بمعايير السلامة الكهربائية والصحة المهنية. موقع العمل ونوعه يقع مقر العمل في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

6a31a01ea69b0c40.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع الشعيبي للبلاستيك عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الهفوف. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة دورة المبيعات الكاملة، بدءًا من بناء علاقات مع العملاء وصولاً إلى إتمام عمليات البيع وتحصيل الديون. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لتقديم عروض بيع دقيقة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وإدارة عملية البيع بفعالية. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمليات. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات في مصنع الشعيبي للبلاستيك بدوام كامل في مدينة الهفوف بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع وإتمام الصفقات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

6ae31898b407974b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المجتهد العربي عن محامٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة القضايا القانونية، إعداد ملفاتها، وجمع الأدلة اللازمة. يتولى المحامي مسؤولية تمثيل الموكلين أمام المحاكم والجهات الرسمية، بالإضافة إلى صياغة وتوثيق العقود والاتفاقيات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال القضايا وتحديد نوعها، تحليل عناصرها، وتقديم الرأي القانوني بشأنها. تحديد وجمع البيانات الشخصية والخطية والأدلة ذات الصلة، وتحضير البينات الخطية (الوثائق والمستندات) والشخصية (شهود الدفاع والإثبات)، وكتابة لائحة الدعوى وحافظات المستندات. تسجيل الدعاوى لدى المحكمة المختصة، متابعة تبليغ المدعى عليه، حضور الجلسات، مناقشة الشهود، وتقديم المرافعة حتى صدور الحكم. تمثيل الموكلين (مدعين أو مدعى عليهم) أمام مختلف درجات المحاكم، واللجان والمجالس الرسمية، والمحكمين، وتقديم المدافعة والمرافعة والإنذارات والاعتراضات والمطالبات. المفاوضة بشأن العقود والاتفاقيات مع الجهات الرسمية وغير الرسمية، وصياغتها وتوثيقها لدى الجهات ذات العلاقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمحاماة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المحاماة. معرفة قوية بالإجراءات القانونية والمحاكم على مختلف درجاتها. القدرة على تحليل القضايا القانونية المعقدة وتقديم حلول فعالة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في صياغة العقود والوثائق القانونية. قدرة عالية على المرافعة والمدافعة أمام الجهات القضائية والرسمية. مهارات تواصل قوية شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على تنظيم الملفات وحفظ البيانات بدقة. بيئة العمل يعمل المحامي في هذا الدور ضمن فريق قانوني في مقر الشركة بالمدينة المنورة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المكتب لمتابعة القضايا والمهام اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

6a0fe97631bbb84e.description: About the Role Siemens Energy is seeking a Site Training Lead to build the workforce for its new power transformer factory in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role requires a seasoned training professional with 5-10 years of experience in a manufacturing background. The Site Training Lead will be responsible for designing role-based curricula, establishing training infrastructure, and leading onboarding processes for both white- and blue-collar employees, aligning with the factory's ramp-up schedule. Role Impact and Contribution The work of the Site Training Lead will directly influence the speed and safety with which teams achieve full productivity. This role strengthens Siemens Energy's capacity to serve customers and partners across the region and supports the company's mission to advance the energy transition. The successful candidate will join a collaborative, globally connected team that values ownership, continuous learning, and contributing to new developments as part of the company's growth. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the site training plan and role-based curricula for white- and blue-collar employees, ensuring workforce readiness aligns with the factory ramp-up schedule. Set up and manage the training infrastructure, including on-site, digital, and hands-on training within the factory and training workshop. Lead the onboarding process and organize onboarding weeks to facilitate smooth integration and rapid productivity for new hires. Coordinate internal trainers, senior experts, and external training providers, and align training needs with local management and the Global Training Manager. Localize and implement global training initiatives, tools, and content, while maintaining accurate records of training activities, participant data, and learning status in relevant systems. Report progress and training KPIs to the project and global training organizations, ensuring safety, quality, and continuous improvement across all training delivery. About Siemens Energy Siemens Energy is an energy technology company with approximately 100,000 employees in over 90 countries. The company develops future energy systems to meet global energy demand reliably and sustainably. Technologies from Siemens Energy's research departments and factories drive the energy transition and contribute to one-sixth of the world's electricity generation. The global team is committed to achieving sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy, upholding a 150-year legacy of innovation focused on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. The Grid Technology Division This role is part of the Grid Technology division, which focuses on enabling a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is central to the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a portfolio of solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Commitment to Diversity Siemens Energy values diversity, which it sees as a source of strength. The company fosters an inclusive environment, fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates individual character and does not discriminate based on ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability, aiming to energize all of society.

6a0d1b981f680579.description: About KBR, Inc. KBR, Inc. is a company driven by innovation and collaboration, dedicated to improving the world responsibly and safely. The organization attracts a diverse workforce and top talent, fostering an environment where expertise thrives on creativity and resourcefulness. Role Overview: Valve Technician II KBR is seeking a Valve Technician II to join its team in Rabigh or Makkah, Makkah region. This full-time role is essential for maintaining rotating equipment in optimal condition. The successful candidate will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of rotating equipment and mechanical systems, ensuring adherence to required standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Allocate maintenance activities to various technicians and assemble the necessary team. Supervise all ongoing jobs and provide progress updates to the Foreman. Organize manpower resources, equipment, and material availability for tasks. Arrange necessary work permits prior to commencing work. Provide technical advice to technicians regarding the proper use of tools and equipment. Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance Planning, and Technical departments to ensure job execution and completion. Ensure accurate SAP data input, history, and actual hours are maintained. Attend daily and weekly maintenance progress meetings. Safety and Compliance Maintain strict compliance with SATORP standards and guidelines. Ensure adherence to safe work practices, hazardous work regulations, and proper PPE usage according to SATORP standards. Encourage the reporting of Near Misses, unsafe conditions, and acts. Participate in Safety audits. Attend scheduled Safety and Technical training sessions. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating proficiency in the maintenance and repair of rotating equipment and mechanical systems.

6a4b6fc3ff8a06ca.description: About the Consulting Opportunity Arbolus is offering a paid consulting opportunity for a Development Director (Real Estate Developer). This is a part-time consulting engagement, not a permanent employment position. Clients, including private equity and consulting firms, are conducting research on real estate development in Saudi Arabia and seek insights from experienced professionals in the field. Consultation Focus Areas Consultations will cover specific topics relevant to real estate development in Saudi Arabia. Experts will share their knowledge on various aspects of the industry. Project pipeline and market demand Selection processes for contractors and consultants Analysis of construction costs, financing strategies, and sales approaches Candidate Profile We are seeking professionals with direct experience in real estate development. Candidates should possess a strong background in managing development projects and related strategies. Current or recent experience as a Development Director, Project Director, or Head of Development at a real estate developer. Demonstrated responsibility for development projects, contractor oversight, or sales strategy. Between 5-10 years of relevant experience is preferred. Consultation Process and Compensation Consultations are structured as paid calls, typically lasting 30-60 minutes. Compensation ranges from $200 to $400 per hour, determined by the consultant's seniority and expertise. Consultants retain full control over which requests they accept. Client engagements strictly adhere to ethical guidelines, ensuring no confidential information about current employers is requested. About Arbolus Arbolus is an expert network based in London. The platform connects clients with experienced professionals for direct insights into companies, markets, and investment opportunities. Experts engage through various formats, including paid calls, written Q&A, and surveys. Interested professionals can create a free profile in approximately five minutes. When a project aligns with a consultant's background, a brief is provided, allowing the consultant to decide on participation.

6aca598dae86312d.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Static Tech I to join their team in Makkah, with locations including Rabigh and Makkah. This full-time position operates under direct supervision, focusing on the execution of daily work assignments and coordination of site activities. Key Responsibilities Explain instructions and documentation to effectively plan work activities. Assist in coordinating the movement of materials and equipment to designated work locations. Set up the work site in preparation for tasks. Complete and review necessary records and documentation. Maintain tools and equipment to ensure operational readiness. Perform various clean-up activities as required. Observe and adhere to all safety rules and procedures, including the consistent use of required personal safety equipment. Qualifications and Requirements High school diploma or equivalent. A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience. Ability to perform moderate to heavy lifting may be required for this role. Experience Level This position requires 2-5 years of experience in a related field, ensuring candidates possess a foundational understanding of static technical operations. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with work locations in Rabigh and Makkah. The role involves working under direct supervision within a structured environment. Application Process Salary information for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

6ad9343c379a80d7.description: About the Role Salla is seeking a Risk Manager for Paylink to lead its Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function as an independent control function. This full-time role involves developing and maintaining the risk management framework, assessing risks across the business, and providing insights to support informed decisions, business resilience, and compliance with Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) requirements. The Risk Manager will collaborate closely with senior management, relevant committees, and departmental risk owners while maintaining independent oversight and clear accountability. Candidates should have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Risk Management Framework and Strategy Develop and update the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, policies, methodologies, tools, and templates for approval. Prepare an annual risk management strategy and work plan aligned with the Company’s strategy, license category, and scale of operations. Define roles, responsibilities, escalation lines, risk owners, and control owners in coordination with relevant departments. Support the Risk Committee and other relevant committees by preparing materials, reports, and tracking decisions. Periodically review the framework following product, business model, regulatory changes, or material events. Risk Identification, Assessment, and Reporting Lead enterprise assessments of inherent and residual risk in collaboration with departmental risk owners. Establish and maintain the enterprise risk register, documenting causes, impacts, controls, assessments, treatment owners, and target dates. Coordinate Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) and challenge the reasonableness of assessments. Assess enterprise risks from new products, services, material changes, projects, expansion, and partnerships. Conduct scenario analyses and stress testing in coordination with Finance, Operations, and Technology. Develop and review the risk appetite statement and tolerance limits with relevant stakeholders. Develop Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), defining data sources, owners, measurement frequency, and alert thresholds. Monitor risk appetite breaches, analyze causes, recommend mitigation, and escalate as needed. Produce periodic reports for senior management and relevant committees on material risks, trends, breaches, and remediation plans. Control Assessment and Independent Challenge Assess control design adequacy and effectiveness from a risk management perspective using supporting evidence. Request information and evidence for risk assessments within approved access rights and confidentiality principles. Document professional disagreements with risk or control owners and escalate material matters through approved channels. Monitor risks related to liquidity, settlements, partner banks, fraud, operations, third parties, concentration, reputation, and strategy. Assess cybersecurity and technology risks within the enterprise framework in coordination with specialist teams. Include money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risks in the enterprise risk register and independently challenge exposures and controls. Access transaction, alert, and suspicion-related indicators for risk assessment, subject to confidentiality restrictions. Ensure enterprise assessments align with specialist risk assessments without transferring ownership of specialist programs. Business Continuity and Third-Party Risk Management Oversee the Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework and program, monitoring plans, testing, and remediation readiness. Review Business Impact Analysis (BIA) results and verify validation of impacts and dependencies. Monitor business continuity, disaster recovery, and crisis management plans and tests. Report material readiness gaps to senior management and relevant committees, coordinating with Compliance on regulatory notifications. Assess risks related to suppliers, outsourcing, third-party dependencies, concentration, and single points of failure. Review risks associated with projects, material changes, and new services, providing recommendations before approval. Track risk mitigation plans, action owners, and deadlines. Regulatory Compliance and Risk Awareness Monitor regulatory requirements applicable to the risk management function and compile supporting evidence. Participate in supervisory visits and respond on enterprise risk management topics. Track regulatory and Internal Audit findings relevant to Risk Management and verify remediation. Deliver practical risk awareness and training to risk owners and promote risk culture throughout the Company. Maintain orderly records of evidence, assessments, reports, decisions, and relevant correspondence.

6a5ba430dc27915c.description: About the Role ASBIS Arabia Distribution is seeking a Key Account Manager IT Distribution to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on driving sales growth and strengthening relationships with key channel partners and resellers across Saudi Arabia within the IT distribution sector. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing existing accounts, acquiring new partners, executing sales strategies, and achieving revenue and profitability targets. Key Responsibilities Manage and develop relationships with key channel partners and resellers across Saudi Arabia. Achieve assigned sales, revenue, margin, and business growth targets. Identify and develop new business opportunities to expand market coverage and increase sales within the assigned territory. Drive partner acquisition, onboarding, development, and retention initiatives. Manage the full sales cycle, including opportunity identification, quotation preparation, negotiation, and deal closure. Develop account plans and sales strategies to maximize growth within assigned accounts. Collaborate with Product, Procurement, and Marketing teams on pricing, promotions, stock planning, and go-to-market activities. Execute vendor strategies and support business development initiatives to increase market share. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer demand, and emerging opportunities within the Saudi IT channel market. Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and provide regular sales forecasts, business updates, and account performance reports. Ensure timely collection of receivables by monitoring customer payment status, following up on outstanding balances, and coordinating with Finance and Credit teams. Coordinate with Logistics, Operations, Product, and Finance teams to ensure smooth order processing and high levels of customer satisfaction. Represent ASBIS and vendor partners during customer meetings, industry events, training sessions, and business reviews. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in IT distribution or a similar field. The role requires a proactive and results-oriented individual with a strong understanding of sales strategies and account management within the IT sector. What ASBIS Offers Opportunity to work for a financially strong, fast-growing multinational company. Constant interaction with global teams of professionals. International career opportunities. Access to continuous professional development, including training, certification programs, events, and team buildings. Competitive salary package and motivation scheme. Life events’ gifts, corporate presents and awards, and years of service bonuses. Work Environment ASBIS is recognized as a Great Place to Work® certified company, emphasizing a workplace culture that supports professional growth and employee potential. The company invests in creating an environment where employees can develop their careers and build a future with the organization.

6acd95f8f21c802d.description: About the Role PepsiCo is seeking a Trade Marketing Manager for Beverages to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to the Trade Marketing agenda for the Beverages business in Saudi Arabia, serving as the primary interface between PepsiCo Marketing, Franchise teams, and the bottlers’ Trade Marketing organizations. The manager will be responsible for translating brand and commercial strategies into effective in-market execution, ensuring optimal allocation and governance of trade investments across channels to achieve sustainable volume, share, and profitability growth. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of annual and quarterly Trade Marketing strategies for KSA Beverages. Translate category and brand priorities into channel-specific activation plans across various channels, including Modern Trade (MT), Traditional Trade (TT), Away From Home (AFH), and e-Commerce. Develop and deploy the trade marketing calendar, incorporating key seasons, product launches, and promotional activities. Drive channel planning as part of Joint Business Planning with bottlers. Act as the primary liaison between PepsiCo and bottlers’ Trade Marketing teams, ensuring alignment on priorities, activation frameworks, and execution standards. Lead regular forums with bottlers to track performance and align on actions. Serve as a key interface between PepsiCo Marketing, Franchise teams, Channel teams, and Bottlers' teams to ensure strong alignment between consumer campaigns and in-store activation. Manage trade spend planning, tracking, and prioritization by channel, establishing frameworks for effective and efficient allocation of all trade investments. Monitor the ROI of activations and reallocate funds to opportunities with the highest return. Lead the execution of Below-The-Line (BTL) activations and customer programs aligned with brand priorities. Ensure best-in-class execution across channels, including store visibility, promotions, and innovation launches (NPDs, new packs, SKUs). Develop and deploy channel playbooks and activation toolkits. Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as volume, share, distribution, and activation effectiveness. Leverage internal and external insights to refine plans and identify growth opportunities. Establish dashboards and feedback loops across stakeholders and bottlers. Lead trade readiness and execution of innovation (NPD) launches across channels. Identify and scale successful activation ideas across channels and geographies. Contribute to mid- and long-term growth planning cycles. 6a58f66daf41ad83.job_title: WHS Officer Workplace health and safety
6a58f66daf41ad83.description: About the Role Al Rabie Saudi Foods Co is seeking a Health and Safety Officer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for conducting routine workplace HSE inspections, monitoring compliance with safety procedures, and reporting unsafe conditions across various operational areas. The role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct scheduled workplace safety inspections and report unsafe acts, conditions, and hazards. Support hazard identification and risk assessments by gathering field information and verifying control implementation. Monitor the application of HSE procedures, PPE requirements, housekeeping, and safe work practices. Check contractor activities and Permit-to-Work (PTW) compliance within assigned areas, referring permit decisions to authorized personnel. Report incidents and near misses promptly, preserve factual information, and assist assigned investigators. Record inspection findings, assign follow-up actions to responsible parties, and verify field implementation. Deliver or support toolbox talks, inductions, and awareness activities as authorized. Participate in emergency drills and report preparedness gaps. Observe fire and life-safety conditions and report defects to the responsible HSE function. Maintain accurate HSE checklists, records, observations, and routine reports. Encourage accurate hazard and near-miss reporting and communicate safety concerns respectfully. Escalate imminent danger and significant non-compliance immediately according to company procedures. Daily Activities Perform daily field walk-throughs of assigned work areas and record inspection results. Verify machine guarding, access routes, housekeeping, storage, material handling, and PPE practices against approved requirements. Observe high-risk work to confirm required controls and permits are in place; stop or escalate unsafe activity within delegated authority. Check contractor site practices and report deviations to the responsible supervisor or permit authority. Attend pre-job briefings and toolbox talks, communicating site-specific hazards. Support the collection of incident facts, photographs, and witness details as directed, without independently assigning root causes or disciplinary responsibility. Update corrective-action tracking records and verify field completion, flagging recurring deficiencies for review. Assist with emergency evacuation exercises, equipment access checks, and assembly-point readiness. Report apparent fire protection system defects and follow up on assigned service requests with relevant teams. Maintain inspection, training attendance, observation, and permit-monitoring records. Provide weekly field observations and unresolved risk updates to the assigned HSE Supervisor or Safety Manager. Participate in site visits to warehouses, depots, and staff accommodation when assigned. Performance Assessment Performance will be assessed based on the quality of field inspections, timeliness of reporting, escalation of significant hazards, accuracy of records, and verified effectiveness of assigned follow-up actions, rather than solely on inspection or observation volume. Reporting Structure and Relationships The Health and Safety Officer reports to the assigned HSE Supervisor, or to the Safety Manager if an HSE Supervisor position does not exist, as defined by the approved organizational chart. This role involves coordination with operational departments, employees, and contractors, but does not include supervision of HSE staff. 6a19af84ea0d2d9f.description: About Yellow Mine Yellow Mine is a Saudi-based conglomerate with over 50 years of history, known for its diversified portfolio including infrastructure solutions, real estate and renewables development, and manufacturing of renewable technologies. Job Summary Yellow Mine is seeking an Exploration Geologist with 0-1 years of experience to support the planning, coordination, and execution of geological exploration activities across its mining and mineral exploration projects in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves conducting geological fieldwork, mapping, mineral identification, geochemical sampling, core logging, and drilling activities. The Exploration Geologist will interpret geological data to support the identification and evaluation of potential mineral deposits, working under the guidance of the Technical Manager or Senior Geologist. This position contributes to exploration programs from initial geological investigations and target generation through drilling, sampling, geological interpretation, and preliminary resource evaluation. The role requires a hands-on geologist willing to work in the field and travel to remote exploration sites, with a focus on developing technical expertise in metallic mineral exploration, particularly for gold, copper, and other economically valuable minerals. Key Responsibilities Conduct geological field investigations, reconnaissance surveys, and geological mapping to identify potential mineralization zones and exploration targets. Identify and document rock types, lithology, geological structures, alteration zones, and mineral occurrences during field activities. Participate in geological sampling activities, including rock-chip, soil, trench, and drill-core sampling. Participate in exploration drilling programs (Reverse Circulation and Diamond Drilling) and coordinate with drilling contractors. Perform geological core and chip logging, documenting lithology, mineralization, alteration, and other relevant geological characteristics. Assist in drill-core handling, photography, sample preparation, labeling, and dispatch to analytical laboratories. Review geological samples and laboratory assay results, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with sampling and QA/QC procedures. Maintain accurate geological records, drilling logs, sample registers, and exploration databases. Compile and interpret geological, geochemical, and geophysical data to support exploration activities and target evaluation. Assist in preparing geological maps, drill-hole sections, cross-sections, and other technical illustrations. Support geological modeling and mineralization interpretation using relevant geological software. Assist in evaluating exploration targets and identifying potential areas for further investigation and drilling. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly geological field reports and provide updates on exploration progress. Assist in preparing technical reports, geological summaries, and presentations for management review. Review historical geological maps, exploration records, and technical information to support exploration planning. Follow company HSE policies and ensure safe working practices during fieldwork, drilling, and sampling activities. Support environmentally responsible exploration practices and comply with applicable Saudi mining and environmental regulations. Coordinate with senior geologists, drilling contractors, laboratories, and other technical service providers to support exploration activities. Participate in geological reviews, technical meetings, and exploration planning activities. Perform other related geological and exploration duties as assigned by the Technical Manager or Senior Geologist. Reporting Structure The Exploration Geologist will report directly to the Yellow Mine Technical Manager or Business Unit Manager (BUM). Internal and External Relationships Internally, this role will interact with all departments, including Operations and Project Management, Engineering, Business Development Commercial, Contracts, Procurement, Finance, and HSE. Externally, the Exploration Geologist will coordinate with clients, government authorities, consultants, drilling companies, EPC/EPCM Contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, JV partners, and other project stakeholders.

6a46ee0b5dfbfeee.description: Mechanical Technician Valve Overhauling, On-Site Machining & Field Service Job Title: Mechanical Technician Department: On-Site Intervention Services Reports To: Specialty Services manager Job Summary The Mechanical Technician is responsible for performing industrial valve inspection, overhauling, repair, testing, and reassembly, as well as precision on-site machining and mechanical field service activities at workshops and client facilities. The role supports maintenance, shutdowns, turnarounds, and emergency interventions across oil and gas, petrochemical, power generation, and other industrial sectors. The position requires practical expertise in valve maintenance, portable machining, mechanical fitting, equipment alignment, and troubleshooting, with a strong commitment to health, safety, quality, and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Valve Overhauling and Maintenance Dismantle, inspect, repair, reassemble, and test industrial valves, including gate, globe, ball, butterfly, check, and control valves. Perform valve lapping, grinding, seat restoration, and replacement of defective components, seals, and gaskets. Diagnose valve leakage, mechanical defects, and operational issues, ensuring correct assembly and reliable performance. Record inspection findings, repair activities, test results, and material replacements. On-Site Machining and Field Services Operate portable machining equipment for flange facing, line boring, milling, drilling, and other precision machining operations. Perform in-situ machining and repair of valves, flanges, pumps, and associated mechanical components. Set up, secure, and align machining equipment, verifying dimensions, tolerances, and surface finish requirements. Carry out mechanical installation, alignment, adjustment, and troubleshooting at client sites. Inspect and maintain machining tools and equipment to ensure safe and reliable operation. Mechanical Maintenance and Field Support Execute mechanical fitting, dismantling, component replacement, reassembly, installation, and maintenance activities. Support planned shutdowns, plant turnarounds, preventive maintenance, and emergency service assignments. Interpret technical drawings, equipment specifications, and maintenance procedures to complete assigned tasks accurately. Coordinate with supervisors, engineers, and client representatives to ensure efficient execution of work. Prepare accurate service reports, inspection records, measurement reports, and job completion documentation. Health, Safety, Quality, and Compliance Comply with company and client HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, risk assessments, and approved work procedures. Follow lockout/tagout (LOTO), equipment isolation, PPE, and other applicable safety requirements. Ensure all work meets specified quality standards, dimensional tolerances, and approved technical procedures. Inspect tools and equipment before use and promptly report unsafe conditions, incidents, defects, and non-conformities. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment at all times. Qualifications and Experience Technical diploma, ITI, vocational certificate, or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Maintenance, or a related discipline. Typically 3 5 years of relevant industrial experience in valve overhauling , mechanical maintenance, on-site machining , or field services. Demonstrated hands-on experience in industrial valve repair, assembly, inspection, and pressure testing. Practical knowledge of portable machining equipment, precision measuring instruments, and mechanical hand tools. Ability to interpret technical drawings, understand mechanical tolerances, and follow maintenance procedures. Experience in oil and gas, petrochemical, refinery, power generation, or other heavy industrial environments is preferred. Shutdown, turnaround, and emergency maintenance experience is an advantage. Technical Skills and Competencies Industrial valve inspection, dismantling, repair, lapping, grinding, and reassembly. Valve pressure testing, functional testing, and sealing surface restoration. Portable flange facing, line boring, milling, drilling, and in-situ machining. Mechanical fitting, equipment alignment, dimensional measurement, and troubleshooting. Understanding of mechanical tolerances, surface finishes, equipment specifications, and quality requirements. Safe operation and basic maintenance of portable machining equipment and workshop tools. Accurate completion of technical reports, inspection records, and service documentation. Strong mechanical aptitude, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, teamwork, and effective communication. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver quality workmanship within project deadlines. Working Conditions and Job Requirements Work in workshops, industrial plants, client facilities, and remote project locations. Availability for site deployment, business travel, overtime, shift work, and extended working hours as required by project needs. Ability to work in demanding industrial environments and comply with applicable site access, safety training, and medical requirements. Maintain professional conduct and demonstrate a customer-focused approach throughout service assignments. Performance Expectations Complete assigned valve overhauling, machining, and mechanical service activities safely and within agreed schedules. Meet specified quality standards, dimensional tolerances, and testing requirements. Minimize rework through accurate inspection, correct assembly, and adherence to approved procedures.
